Transferor of real property subject to 89-1-501 to 89-1-523 must deliver a written property condition disclosure statement to the prospective transferee, as soon as practicable before transfer of title in a sale.
If a disclosure or material amendment is delivered after an offer, the transferee has 3 days after in-person delivery or 5 days after mailing to terminate the offer by written notice.
If the transferor fails to deliver or complete the statement, the transferee is presumed on notice to inquire; licensees have no duty or discipline for the disclosure.
Transferor is not liable for errors not within personal knowledge, or based on timely information from public agencies or other providers, if ordinary care was exercised.
A transfer is not invalidated solely for noncompliance, but a person who willfully or negligently violates is liable for the transferee's actual damages.
Transfers pursuant to court order, execution writs, foreclosure sales and certain fiduciary transfers are excluded from the disclosure requirement.
